item.title: Chillicothe Board of Public Works
item.description: Chillicothe’s Board of Public Works will meet Tuesday morning at the CMU office. The meeting begins at 8:00 am and will include reports from the department heads and from the General Manager. Board of Public Works meetings are open to the public.

item.title: Grundy County Sheriff’s Report
item.description: The Grundy County Sheriff’s report for the final week of January includes five jail bookings, three people released from custody, and they processed two sex offenders. In addition, the deputies handled juvenile problems, careless and reckless driving complaints, made two traffic stops, assisted motorists, and assisted the children’s division.
